questions.question: The Russian source gives both age 12 and 1748 for Rumovsky's selection for the Academic Gymnasium, although he was born in 1734. Confirm the entry year against an authoritative biography. The English draft retains 1748 and omits the contradictory age; the RAS page could not be fetched during this review.
questions.resolution: Retained 1748 for the start of studies and omitted the contradictory age. P. G. Kulikovsky in the Complete Dictionary of Scientific Biography confirms the 1748 move from seminary to the Academy university; an English reference is added. The Russian original remains unchanged.
